paper.title: WebGPT: Browser-assisted question-answering with human feedback
paper.central_claim: 把 GPT-3 微调为可操作文本化网页浏览环境（Bing 搜索、点击、滚动、引用）的长问答 agent：先用人类示范做行为克隆，再用人类比较训练奖励模型，并对奖励模型做拒绝采样；答案须附带浏览中收集的引用以便人类评估事实性。最佳模型（175B BC + best-of-64）的答案在 ELI5 上被偏好于人类示范者的 56%、Reddit 最高票回答的 69%，在 TruthfulQA 上 75% 为真、54% 为真且有信息。

provenance.independence_note: Aggregation over two seat inputs; the fixed paper text was read in full before the seat scores, but this is not a third blind review or human gold. All results are author reports; nothing was reproduced.

preliminary_evidence_judgment: Read before seat scores. WebGPT fine-tunes GPT-3 (760M/13B/175B) to operate a text-rendered browser on the live web (Bing search, click link IDs, find, scroll, back, quote; read-only) and answer ELI5 questions with references; BC on ~6k demonstrations, a reward model on ~16k comparisons, PPO, and best-of-n rejection sampling. Outcomes are human pairwise preferences (56% vs demonstrators, 69% vs Reddit) and human TruthfulQA scoring; no execution checker. Controls: same-base BC vs RL vs BoN vs RL+BoN with a tuned BC baseline, scaling via a validation RM proxy. Missing: no-browsing or fixed-retrieval baseline on ELI5, no reference ablation; TruthfulQA compares GPT-3 scored by the automated metric with WebGPT scored by humans; BoN uses up to 64x inference compute (addressed by a compute-efficiency frontier only via RM proxy). Method/environment documentation is exceptionally complete. Scope edge: browser agent with a real action surface, but read-only QA with human-judged outcome.

scope_decision.reason: Final scope decision (edge, kept): the policy observes a text rendering of live web pages and issues sequential browser commands (search, click link IDs, find, scroll, back, quote; agg:G-A07). That is a browser operation surface, so it is not excluded as a pure API/function-calling agent, and the contribution (environment + BC/RM/RL/best-of-n training of the browsing policy) is an agent training method evaluated in an interactive environment. Edge because the task is read-only QA (agg:G-A08) and outcomes are human-preference judgments, not execution-checked task completion; claim_type system_method is kept. Its score must not be read as evidence of GUI task-execution competence.

signatures.object: 文本化网页浏览环境与动作接口（相对基线：可微检索 RAG/REALM；Krishna 2021 的 ELI5 检索系统）
signatures.information: 问题、当前页简化文本（Readability.js→html2text，链接编码为 【id†text†domain】）、搜索结果页、剩余动作数、已引用片段、过去动作摘要；不可见：页面样式/图像（图像仅替换为 alt 文本）。
signatures.operation: 模型每步输出 10 种文本命令之一（Search/Click/Find/Quote/Scroll/Back/Top/End…）；以 Bing 为检索；浏览结束后基于引用生成最终回答。
signatures.conditions: 最多 100 次浏览动作（评估）；移除 reddit/quora，并屏蔽与问题/参考答案 10-gram 重叠的页面；只读（无表单提交）。
signatures.feedback: 页面文本（不可预测的实时网页）；奖励模型分数仅在回答阶段。
signatures.persistence: 不跨问题保存；会话内摘要。
signatures.claimed_effect: 使 BC/RM/RL 等通用方法可直接优化检索与综合；回答带引用便于人类核查。
signatures.failure_boundary: 分布外问题、不可靠来源、引用挑选偏向、偏见放大；只读环境。

retained_trace.reason: 静态训练/接口设计，无留存或自我改进声称。

signatures.object: 用人类偏好奖励模型优化浏览+回答：BC → RM → 对 RM 的拒绝采样（及可选 PPO RL）
signatures.information: 示范者看到与模型相同的信息（仅少数界面差异）；比较者看到问题、回答与引用；比较时不要求独立调研。
signatures.operation: BC 于约 6,000 示范；RM 于约 16,000 比较（最终总体评分，平局为 50% 软标签）；评估时采样 n（4/16/64）个完整 episode，取 RM 最高者；RL 用 PPO + 每 token KL 惩罚。
signatures.conditions: 互不相交的 BC/RM/RL 问题集；BC 早停用 RM 分数；温度 0.8。
signatures.feedback: 人类偏好（离线收集）→ RM；RL 阶段 RM 作为奖励。
signatures.selection_rule: best-of-n：按 RM 分数选最高；RL 早停按 RM 分数与 KL 预算。
signatures.selection_data: RM 训练 16k 比较；验证 RM 在独立划分上训练用于缩放实验。
signatures.persistence: 模型权重、公开比较数据集（19,578 条）。
signatures.later_use: 推理时每个问题独立采样。
signatures.claimed_effect: 175B best-of-64：56%（对示范者）、69%（对 Reddit）；best-of-64 BC 对 BC 68%；RL 对 BC 58%；组合 RL+拒绝采样无收益。
signatures.failure_boundary: RM 在大 n 过优化；对挑选引用的激励；标注者难以发现细微幻觉。

retained_trace.reason: 离线人类反馈训练，不是自我改进闭环；选择只在推理时发生（best-of-n），不改变持久策略。

gap.author_gap: 长问答（LFQA）系统落后于人类；已有工作聚焦检索与综合各自改进。人类难以独立核查事实，使得以事实性为目标的反馈数据昂贵且主观。
gap.checked_gap: 文内部分证据：Krishna 2021 的最佳模型仅 23% 优于参考答案(EV18)；自动指标（ROUGE-L）不可靠(EV32)；标注者发现细微幻觉很难(EV27)。“LFQA 落后于人类”及 Krishna 的数字来自引用，原文不在固定包；因此是“部分核实”。

lineage.name: Shi 2017（World of Bits）、Gur 2018 等网页 BC/RL

gap.closest_adjacent: Krishna 2021（同任务同数据，算力远小）与 Adolphs 2021（搜索 agent 的 BC/RL）；二者原文不在固定包，故仅作自述核对。
gap.residue: 事实性评估依赖引用而非独立调研；奖励利用（挑选引用）、偏见、分布外错误。
gap.stakes: LFQA 可能成为学习获取信息的主要方式；错误会被带引用的“权威感”放大(EV29,EV30)。
gap.method_response: 构建人类可执行的文本化浏览环境，使模仿学习和人类反馈可直接用于检索+综合；以模型收集的引用降低人类事实核查难度。
gap.remaining_gap: 引用不等于事实核查，可能被利用；分布外（TruthfulQA）仍弱；环境只读且为文本；未与无浏览的 GPT-3 在 ELI5 上对照；推理算力对比未对齐。
unresolved: Krishna/RAG 等原文不在固定包

facts: 后续 GUI-agent 论文将 WebGPT 作为早期 Web agent（AgentTrek 引言）
WebArena 将其归入“搜索并读取结果”的交互式 agent 工作

gap.aggregate_neighbor_check: Krishna21, Stiennon20, Adolphs21, Yuan19 are not in the fixed pack; lineage stays author-attributed (both seats). WGE (1802.08802, this batch) confirms the adjacent browser BC/RL line WebGPT cites as task automation rather than QA.

tactic_steps_checked.note: 检索与综合原本由各自定制的管线负责(RAG/REALM、专门检索器)(EV03)
把浏览器序列化为文本接口（简化文本+特殊链接记号+命令词表），让 LM 配方可迁移(EV04,EV06)；未独立验证该接口“携带语义”
同一 GPT-3 以 BC/RM/RL 统一目标处理浏览与回答(EV01)
无与“固定检索+生成”或“去掉浏览”的受控对照来分离接口贡献
超过人类示范者的偏好和 TruthfulQA 提升，但对手算力不对等(EV18,EV19)

success_checks.note: 对 Krishna 2021 与 UnitedQA 有对比但算力差异大(EV18,EV40)

failure_checks.note: 缺“同算力 RAG”或“无浏览 GPT-3 on ELI5”对照

matches.reason: 最贴近的原卡操作：把网页浏览序列化成 LM 可用的文本接口，使统一配方端到端优化检索与综合。奖励模型/拒绝采样这一人类反馈流程在 15+31 中没有直接对应（C26 的信号来源是“非人类”），所以只选这一操作；fit=partial。

tactic_steps_checked.note: 检索交给 Bing；LM 负责浏览决策与综合(EV03)
引用片段（页面标题、域名、摘录）是可由人类核查的结构化中间物(EV07)
验证者是人类偏好训练的 RM，而非 sound solver(EV10)
无去掉引用/检索的消融
推理算力 Pareto 与 TruthfulQA/TriviaQA 迁移(EV26,EV19,EV40)

failure_checks.note: RM 可被过优化、引用可被挑选(EV30,EV41)

matches.reason: “Bing 外包+引用交接”是独立的第二项操作，因它改变的是责任边界与可验证中间物，而不是统一接口；因验证者是学习的 RM，fit=partial。

rs_pattern.reason: 接口序列化与委托边界两项操作可映射；人类反馈 RM + 拒绝采样没有对应原卡，已在 reason 中注明未被覆盖。

executes_pattern.note: 统一接口与委托均执行，但缺接口消融与同算力对照

resolves_problem.note: 对示范者/Reddit 的人工偏好领先，但事实性/分布外问题未关闭；作者自述仍弱于人类。

rs_pattern.aggregate_reason: Both seats choose unify_into_shared_representation/C18 (text serialisation of browser state into one LM policy). The second distinct operation, outsourcing retrieval to an external engine and returning quote references as an inspectable intermediate artifact for human evaluation, is recorded as decompose_and_delegate supporting (sub null: the verifier is a learned preference RM/humans, not a sound solver). The RM + rejection-sampling human-feedback loop has no clean original-card counterpart, as son55 notes.

condition_checks.reason: Whole-run candidates and separately trained human-preference scorer implement direct reranking.
No simulation: per-candidate quotes/answer preserved; final-state GUI success is not being checked.
N and compute frontier stated, no full latency or equal-cost scorer control.
Terminal graded score is used for PPO/ranking.
Input answer/reference bundle and human-preference target differ from GUI-success screenshot verdict; do not claim binary verifier reliability.
Held-out comparison evaluation and human audits present; no unseen-agent success precision/NPV.
SimplifiedHTML/PDF/text and indexed link targets explicitly replace screen pixels.
Observation privileges and loss of layout/images are stated; not equivalent to pixel-grounding skill.

condition_checks.note: 接口匹配可得结构：简化文本+链接 ID，不需要像素(EV04,EV06)
粒度粗：无表单/图像/点击坐标，只读环境(EV31,EV42)

matches.reason: 重新定义了 LM 与浏览器之间的动作抽象（10 条文本命令、链接 ID 动作）——K29 的“改动作接口”；它不是桌面/移动 GUI 操作而是只读信息检索浏览。

condition_checks.note: RL 从 BC 模型初始化(EV22)
每 token KL 惩罚；早停按 RM 分数与 KL 预算
RL 仅作次要实验，主结果不采用(EV13)

matches.reason: RL 部分：BC 初始化 + 终端 RM 奖励 + KL 约束，对应 K20；但奖励来自人类偏好 RM（非可执行判据），且 RL 对 BC 仅 58% 并在最终系统中被舍弃。

revision_proposals.proposal: 无新卡建议：K02/K29 已覆盖；WebGPT 属范围边缘（只读问答浏览），建议仅作为来源增补。

domain_pattern.aggregate_note: Union of both seats: K02 best-of-n reranking with a learned scorer; K16 partial (outcome RM on answers, preference not success); C01 element-id actions on enumerated link IDs; K29 partial (a redesigned text command interface); K20 partial (PPO from BC with terminal RM reward and KL; executed but dropped from the final system). Not scored.

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: C18 的“把非原生模态序列化进主流 LM 配方”对应 WebGPT 的文本化浏览接口；K29 的“重新定义模型与计算机间的动作抽象”是同一操作在浏览器域的实例。
pattern_mapping.necessary_conditions_and_differences: C18 要求接口消融；WebGPT 无。K29 面向 GUI 操作，WebGPT 为只读信息检索。

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: “把验证交给独立验证者、选择最高分”的 RS 闭环（弱）对应 K02 的轨迹级验证重排。
pattern_mapping.necessary_conditions_and_differences: RS 骨架要求 sound/机器可检验的验证；K02 的验证者可学习，但需要精度显著高于 50%。WebGPT 的 RM 精度未直接报告。

claims.text: 175B best-of-64 的答案在 ELI5 测试集被偏好于人类示范者答案的 56%。
claims.setting: 同标准、带引用的成对人工比较；新增答案来自模型 vs 示范者（使用同一浏览环境）
claims.selection_vs_test: ELI5 测试集问题；BC/RM/RL 问题集互斥；采样 n 与温度在人工评估中选出
claims.result_denominator: Figure 2（仅图）；平局计 50%；±1 标准误；样本数文本未给
claims.allowed_conclusion: 作者报告：在作者的比较规程下，带引用的模型答案略多于人类示范者答案被偏好；判断者难以发现细微幻觉，因此不等同于“事实性更高”。

claims.text: 答案在 ELI5 上被偏好于 Reddit 最高票回答的 69%（对比 Krishna 2021 的 23%）。
claims.setting: 去引用，新承包商，最小指令；Reddit 回答风格不同
claims.baseline_control: Reddit 最高票回答；Krishna 2021（引用数字）
claims.allowed_conclusion: 作者报告 69%；盲法不足且与 Krishna 的对比算力不对等；作者自己认为对示范者的比较更有意义。

claims.text: TruthfulQA：WebGPT 回答 75% 为真、54% 为真且有信息，优于 GPT-3。
claims.setting: 回答截断为 50 token，人工评估；GPT-3 用自动指标
claims.result_denominator: Figure 3；约 3% 空答案记为“真但无信息”
claims.allowed_conclusion: WebGPT 在该集上比 GPT-3 更真实，但仍弱于人类，并会引用不可靠来源；评估方法在两个系统间不一致（人工 vs 自动）。

claims.text: 拒绝采样优于 RL，二者组合无额外收益；增益随示范数、参数量、采样数增长（有推理算力的 Pareto 取舍）。
claims.setting: 175B；RM 缩放实验以验证 RM 为代理
claims.selection_vs_test: 缩放用验证 RM 分数；主比较用人工
claims.allowed_conclusion: 在作者配置下，RS 以更多推理算力换来比 RL 更大的偏好增益；RL 的调参空间与 RM 过优化是未隔离的混杂因素。

assessment.evidence_level_reason: Actual live text-browser episodes judged by humans (pairwise preference on ELI5, human truthfulness scoring on TruthfulQA); human judgment is the ground-truth standard EVIDENCE.md rule 3 accepts for validating judges. Not execution-checked, read-only, question-OOD only, so not transfer.
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Author-reported: in a read-only text browser on the live web, 175B BC + best-of-64 against a human-preference reward model produces ELI5 answers preferred 56% to same-interface human demonstrators and 69% to top Reddit answers under the authors' protocols; best-of-n beats BC (68%) more than PPO (58%) on the same base; TruthfulQA truthfulness exceeds GPT-3 but the scorers differ. That browsing or references cause the gains, factual accuracy, and any GUI task competence are not established.
not_supported: Gains attributable to browsing/references (no no-browse or fixed-retrieval control on ELI5)
assessment.retention_trace: No retained-improvement claim; trained weights and per-episode quotes only.

G.reason: Concrete LFQA bottleneck (retrieval/synthesis not optimised for supported answer quality; automatic metrics unreliable; factual evaluation hard) with named lineage and stated residuals; originals author-attributed and the necessity of browsing is not tested.

M.reason: Human-performable interface enables BC/RM/RL; references ease evaluation; testable distinctions among BC/RL/BoN; the reference-as-fact-check assumption is questioned by the authors themselves.

X.reason: Operation chain fully reconstructable: environment simplification and link encoding, command set and invalid-action rule, memory via summary, demonstration-interface differences, data collection protocol, RM/RL/BC/BoN steps with hyperparameters and early stopping, anti-cheating censoring, read-only permissions; failure boundaries (OOD, cherry-picked references, overoptimisation, bias) stated. Loss of page layout is a disclosed design boundary, not an unspecified step.

E.measurement.reason: Detailed human comparison protocol with agreement audits (73-74%) and a separate minimal-instruction blinded Reddit comparison; limits stated (subtle hallucinations hard to spot, style unblinding). Deductions: no execution checker, preference not truth, TruthfulQA scorer mismatch, denominators figure-only.

E.causality.reason: Same-base BC/RL/BoN/RL+BoN comparisons with a tuned BC baseline are controlled, but the system-level attributions are not: no no-browsing or fixed-retrieval control on ELI5, no reference ablation, the human-feedback-is-essential inference is argued from the 56% headline, BoN gains are confounded with up to 64x inference compute (matched only via RM proxy), and TruthfulQA uses different scorers for GPT-3 and WebGPT.

E.holdout.reason: Question-disjoint BC/RM/RL sets, held-out ELI5 test, TruthfulQA as OOD, reddit/quora blocking and 10-gram censoring; live-web leakage cannot be excluded and some hyperparameters were tuned with human evaluations.

E.statistics.reason: Human evaluations carry +-1 SE and ties are handled explicitly; empty-answer denominator disclosed; sample counts, seeds and tests are absent from text.

E.cost.reason: Inference compute is an explicit budget with a compute-efficiency frontier (n vs size), labelling time per demonstration/comparison and contractor structure are reported, and the compute disparity vs Krishna is disclosed; total training compute, latency and dollar cost are missing.

E04 targets claims of task success on live websites; WebGPT's live-web claim is QA answer quality with a read-only browser, a different outcome. Live-drift concerns are covered by E20 (both seats: unmet).

Applies (trained end-to-end browser policy, improved outcome claimed; son55's n/a is wrong) and is partially met by the same-backbone tuned-BC comparison; no prompted-framework baseline. Not a challenge to the expectation (sol): the human-preference outcome is the paper's own task-success analogue.

The RM is used as reward and as a best-of-n filter, so E10 applies; it is validated against held-out human comparisons and the validation RM tracks human preference for BoN (not under RL), but no agreement numbers in text and no agent-disjoint check.

The validation RM is asserted reliable as an evaluator proxy (agg:G-A06), so E11 applies, but it is a pairwise Elo preference model with no positive/negative success verdicts; precision/NPV per class is undefined for it. The relevant reliability evidence (agreement with human preference in the BoN regime, unreliability under RL) is reported; challenge rather than unmet.
Human-evaluation results carry +-1 SE (an interval over the question sample); no repeated training seeds and denominators figure-only.

The headline compares the model with human demonstrators, whose interface is designed to give the same information and actions as the model, with two disclosed exceptions (agg:G-A09); this is the matched-observation reporting E21 asks for.
Results are reported across 760M/13B/175B with scaling trends; E22 asks for results across backbone sizes, which is met (architecture-family generality is beyond the expectation).

ELI5/TruthfulQA include nonsensical or false-premise questions and the environment offers End: Nonsense/Controversial, so E25 applies; refusal behaviour is described qualitatively (WebGPT almost always answers) without a calibrated refusal measure.
No self-generated tasks, explored transitions, memory or synthesised environments are claimed to improve benchmark success; question disjointness is assessed under E.holdout.
